g.text: I. Mathematical Pipeline: SourceCode_.ko → Lexer/Parser→ AST →ScopeResolver→ EngineTarget →Execution→ State'
(java.base modules; decoupled error reporting; IPC serialization)
Semantic Analysis → Symbol Table → Optimizations (SSA, HIR/LIR)
Memory Safety Management → Native Backend CodeGen
Loop statement → packaged as IR → handed to Loop.cpp (unroll/opt) → state delta returned to VM
Import statement → handed to Import.java (load module) → new identifiers inserted into Scope Table
All other statements → executed by Runtime VM
